correctness.rationale: For each selected core vertex c_0, every other occupied fiber forms an independent set in a cycle-geodesic obstruction graph. A matching of floor(n/2)-1 disjoint obstruction edges bounds its independence number by ceil(n/2). The explicit one-sided independent set (plus the antipodal odd-cycle vertex) gives a general-position witness with ceil(n/2)+1 vertices; adding any vertex violates GP. The all-leaf set is the only leaf-only maximal set and the only maximum, n>=4. Original-definition exhaustive enumeration of 349504 subsets for n=3..9 and matching/witness checks n=4..40 support boundary checks but do not replace the proof.
